soap:Envelope.soap:Body:
<{{ action }}Response xmlns="http://www.msn.com/webservices/AddressBook">
			<{{ action }}Result>
				
					{%- for activity in activities %}
					{%- if activity.user %}
					{%- set tile = 'https://' ~ settings.USERSTORAGE_HOST ~ '/avatar/' ~ activity.user.uuid ~ '/im' %}
					{%- set profile = 'https://' ~ settings.WEBSITE_HOST ~ '/profile/+' ~ activity.user.username %}
					{%- else %}
					{%- set profile = activity.url or 'https://' ~ settings.WEBSITE_HOST %}
					{%- endif %}
					
						{{ owner_cid }}
						{% if activity.type == 1 %}msgr_status_{{ activity.id }}{% elif activity.type == 3 %}msgr_dp_{{ activity.id }}{% elif activity.type == 2 %}msgr_photo_{{ activity.id }}{% else %}announcement_{{ activity.date_created.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S') }}_{{ activity.id }}{% endif %}
						{{ 1275182653 if activity.user else 420 }}
						{{ activity.type|int }}
						{{ date_format(activity.date_created) }}
						
							{%- if activity.user %}
							
								
									Live.RecentActivity.UserTileM{{ tile }}
									Live.RecentActivity.UserTileL{{ tile }}
									Live.RecentActivity.UserTileXL{{ tile }}
								
								publisher
								{{ cid_format(activity.user.uuid, decimal = True) }}
								{{ activity.user.status.name|e }}
								{{ tile }}
								{{ profile }}
								{{ bool_to_str(activity.user.uuid in detail.contacts and contact_is_favorite(detail, detail.contacts[activity.user.uuid])) }}
							
							
								
									Live.RecentActivity.IsSelfPageUrltrue
								
								AppName
								{{ profile }}
								{{ profile }}
							
							{%- if activity.type == 3 %}
							
								StatusText
								has a new display picture
							
							
								DisplayPicture
								{{ tile }}
								{{ profile }}
								{{ profile }}
							
							{%- elif activity.type == 2 %}
							
								CanonicalStatusText
								{{ (activity.text or 'shared a photo')|e }}
							
							
								Photo
								{{ activity.url|e }}
								{{ activity.url|e }}
								{{ activity.url|e }}
							
							{%- else %}
							
								CanonicalStatusText
								{{ activity.text|e }}
							
							{%- endif %}
							{%- else %}
							
								publisher
								0
								{{ activity.title|e }}
								
								{{ profile|e }}
								false
							
							
								AppName
								{{ profile|e }}
								Announcements
								{{ profile|e }}
							
							
								CanonicalStatusText
								{{ activity.text|e }}
							
							{%- endif %}
						
						1000000{{ activity.type|int if activity.user else 0 }}-0000-4000-8000-{{ '%012x'|format(activity.id) }}
						
							0
						
						
							{{ '%.7f'|format(1 / (1 + (now - activity.date_created).total_seconds() / 86400)) }}
						
						false
						0
						false
					
					{%- endfor %}
				
				
					{%- if 3 in types %}
					
						1275182653
						Messenger
						0
						0
						3
						{{ locale|e }}
						
							{{ locale|e }}
						
						2116
						
							
								One
								{image:DisplayPicture style="floatleft"}
								{publisher-id:publisher} {text:StatusText="has a new display picture"}
								
									
										MessengerGrid
										
											TypePhoto
											PrimaryImage{image:DisplayPicture}
											Publisher{publisher-id:publisher}
											Action{text:StatusText="has a new display picture"}
										
									
								
							
						
						
							status
							photo
						
						false
						false
					
					{%- endif %}
					{%- if 2 in types %}
					
						1275182653
						Messenger
						0
						0
						2
						{{ locale|e }}
						
							{{ locale|e }}
						
						2116
						
							
								One
								{image:Photo style="floatleft"}
								{publisher-id:publisher} {text:CanonicalStatusText}
								
									
										MessengerGrid
										
											TypePhoto
											PrimaryImage{image:Photo}
											Publisher{publisher-id:publisher}
											Action{text:CanonicalStatusText}
										
									
								
							
						
						
							status
							photo
						
						false
						false
					
					{%- endif %}
					{%- for change_type, application_id, application_name in ((1, 1275182653, 'Messenger'), (20, 420, 'Announcements')) if change_type in types %}
					
						{{ application_id }}
						{{ application_name }}
						0
						0
						{{ change_type }}
						{{ locale|e }}
						
							{{ locale|e }}
						
						2116
						
							
								One
								
								{publisher-id:publisher} {text:CanonicalStatusText}
								
									
										MessengerGrid
										
											TypeStatus
											Publisher{publisher-id:publisher}
											Action{text:CanonicalStatusText}
											{%- if change_type == 20 %}
											Footervia {hlink:AppName}
											{%- endif %}
										
									
								
							
						
						
							status
						
						false
						false
					
					{%- endfor %}
				
				https://{{ settings.SOCIAL_HOST }}
			</{{ action }}Result>
		</{{ action }}Response>
